pages.title: Collège Champittet | International School in Lausanne
blocks: THE SWISS SCHOOL, OPEN TO THE WORLD

Collège Champittet offers a truly unique education that combines more than 120 years of Swiss tradition with international innovation. Our approach will inspire your child to achieve remarkable academic results and become a gifted bilingual communicator. Our community will instil passion and purpose in everything they do, too. Together, this develops the skills and values our students need to succeed today, at the world’s best universities, and as the leaders of tomorrow.

Our longstanding reputation for excellence is well-earned. But what really sets us apart is our global outlook, values, and purpose-driven community, which inspires our students to achieve so much more.
A PASSPORT TO A BRIGHT FUTURE

For more than 120 years, our international school in Lausanne has set the highest educational standards Our unwavering commitment to excellence will ensure your child fulfils their academic potential, as they immerse themselves in the world’s finest curricula – including the Swiss Maturité, French Baccalaureate, and International Baccalaureate – in a truly bilingual environment. Learning is enriched by collaborations with world-leading organisations, too, including The Juilliard School, Massachusetts Institute of Technology, and UNICEF. Our one-of-a-kind approach – underpinned by strong family values and a genuine sense of social purpose – sees our students achieve outstanding results . This includes a 100% Swiss Maturité pass rate, which guarantees entry to prestigious universities in Switzerland and across the globe.
LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR ACADEMIC EXCELLENCE
A 21ST CENTURY EDUCATION, 120 YEARS IN THE MAKING
Our globally respected curricula – created by world-leading education experts – reimagines learning through six core pillars.

Our commitment to Swiss standards of excellence – enriched by the very best international curricula, programmes, and experiences – will inspire your child to achieve remarkable success, opening doors to the world’s top universities.
Some of the world's best teachers

Our talented teachers know what it takes to inspire excellence. Using their abundant experience and wealth of qualifications, they’ll ensure your child is engaged, motivated, and learns in a way that enables them to flourish.

Extraordinary learning opportunities are part of every student’s day. Through extra-curricular clubs, residential adventures, and innovative collaborations with The Juilliard School and MIT, your child will do what they love and discover new passions.

Our strong sense of social purpose will enrich your child’s education, instilling values of respect, ambition, courage, openness, and integrity, and preparing them to become a global leader of tomorrow.

Collège Champittet is a school unlike any other. Here, 120 years of Swiss traditions, culture, and heritage combine with a modern, global outlook to create a truly special atmosphere. You’ll feel the sense of history and warm community spirit from the moment you join us, as we welcome you into our family.

Our Swiss and international school campus is an inspiring place to learn, create, and grow. Ideally located on the shore of Lake Geneva, our pristine environment, specialist facilities, and the latest technology bring learning to life.

For our boarders, Collège Champittet is so much more than a school. We’re a second home, an extended family, and a place where learning, fun, and friendships are available 24/7. Our students live in a renovated house on the Collège Champittet Pully Campus, which is set amongst four hectares of towering trees and beautiful green spaces. We offer boarding for young people aged from 10 to 18, who are supported, mentored, and guided by a caring community of experienced house parents.

Our action-packed camps will ensure your child makes the most of their school holidays. Open to all ages and running year-round, our camps range from music and multi-sports to tennis and technology. We also host a a one-of-a-kind Leadership Camp for teens, supported by renowned institutions such as EHL (École Hôtelière de Lausanne, the world’s top hospitality school). All our camps are led by professional coaches and instructors, who will ensure your child creates lasting memories, develops lifelong skills, and makes the most of our spectacular surroundings.
JOIN OUR INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL IN LAUSANNE

We’re delighted you’re considering Collège Champittet for your child’s education. Your journey starts with our friendly admissions team, who will get to know your family and support your child’s move to our school.
Get in touch with us today – complete our short online registration form.
Visit our international school in Lausanne – or book a virtual tour.
Your child can join us for a trial day to get a feel for our school.

pages.title: Social Purpose | Collège Champittet
blocks: At Collège Champittet, we’re committed to making the world a better place. Our strong sense of social purpose will instil the values of respect, ambition, courage, openness, and integrity in your child, and prepare them to become a global leader of tomorrow.

The Collège Champittet Foundation is the beating heart of community life at our school. Established in 2010, the Foundation brings students, parents, and staff together to work towards a common purpose, supporting disadvantaged children in Thailand, Madagascar, and Lebanon, as well as across Switzerland. Working closely with local and international charities, our students raise money, plan projects, and see the tangible impact of their hard work on field trips to partner communities. This not only gives them a fresh perspective on the world, but also helps them to develop vital leadership, organisational, and teamwork skills.

Through our exclusive collaboration with UNICEF, your child will learn about urgent international issues – like the UN Sustainable Development Goals and climate change – and work on inspiring solutions through UNICEF’s Global Challenge programme. Activities surrounding World Children’s Day also teach our students about their rights, how to protect them, and how to advocate for those who may not have a voice.

Our caring international environment is the perfect place for your child to take the lead. On our Champittet Foundation Committee, Student Council, and as class representatives, our extraordinary young leaders grow in confidence and demonstrate creative thinking, problem-solving, and collaborative skills. They also cultivate a strong sense of purpose and community across the school.
SWISS EXCELLENCE, FIT FOR THE FUTURE

Our one-of-a-kind educational approach – which is infused with strong family values, a global outlook, and a genuine sense of collective responsibility – sees our students achieve outstanding academic results.

pages.title: Admissions | Collège Champittet | Day and Boarding School
blocks: We can’t wait to welcome your family to Collège Champittet.

We’re thrilled you’re considering Collège Champittet for your child’s education. On our spectacular lakeside campus , more than 120 years of Swiss tradition, culture, and heritage combine with a modern, global outlook to create a truly special atmosphere. Inspired by our family values, commitment to excellence, and uplifting community spirit, your child will flourish. You’ll feel part of something unique, too, welcomed into a vibrant international family of more than 50 nationalities.

Everyone’s welcome at Collège Champittet. Our day school is open to children aged from 3 to 18, and we offer boarding for 11 to 18-year-olds. Your child can join us at any time – we accept applications all year round. After making an enquiry and taking a tour , your child is welcome to join us for a taster day. You’ll then need to complete our online application form
LEARN MORE ABOUT OUR ENTRY REQUIREMENTS
TALK TO THE COLLÈGE CHAMPITTET ADMISSIONS TEAM

We know that choosing the right school for your child is one of the biggest decisions you’ll make. That’s where our friendly admissions team come in. They’ll work around your family’s schedule and provide the expert information, advice, and answers you need.
Get in touch with us today – fill in our online registration form, give us a call, or send an email.
Visit our campus in person ( book a visit online ) or join us for a virtual tour.
We’ll walk you through our step-by-step admissions process.

Our fees reflect the unique education we offer at Collège Champittet – as well as the excellence our students achieve. Learning here, your child will become a skilled multilingual communicator, earn outstanding academic results , and enjoy extraordinary extra-curricular activities. They’ll also develop the values, skills, and sense of purpose they need to become a successful global citizen.
Ready to start your child’s application ? Here’s what you need to do next.
Start your admissions journey to Collège Champittet by filling in our online enquiry form. Interested in boarding? Let us know! We’ll typically get back to you within 48 hours.

We’d love to show you around our campuses, where you’ll hear from our brilliant students, explore our facilities, and see how we deliver excellence. If you can’t make it to Pully (Lausanne) or Nyon, we’ll happily arrange a virtual tour.
Our open days are a great opportunity to meet our wider community – including other new families – and enjoy a guided tour of our school.
We’re pleased to accept applications all year round. As well as filling in our online form, you’ll also need to send us some supporting documents.
After reviewing your form and documents, we’ll offer your child a place within two weeks of receiving your application. To accept, you’ll need to sign our admissions letter and pay a deposit.
Our calendar contains key term and holiday dates for the upcoming academic year.
Meeting new families is a joy, and we’ll make sure you receive the best possible care and attention. We can't wait to help your child settle in and watch them grow and flourish.

The best way to get a feel for life at Collège Champittet is to visit our stunning campus on the banks of Lake Geneva. Our admissions team can arrange a private tour or schedule an online virtual discovery meeting. We also hold Open Days throughout the year. Get in touch with us today to find out more.
How quickly do you respond to enquiries?
We aim to get back to you within 48 hours of receiving your admissions enquiry (working hours, Monday to Friday).
